user.title: Ring Intercom Health
user.description: Create a watchdog that checks Ring runtime connection health and reloads the selected Ring config entry when the API/listener looks degraded.

data.name: Name
data.active_api_probe: Actively probe the Ring API coordinator
data.api_max_age_seconds: Maximum age of last successful Ring API check
data.require_listener_started: Require Ring realtime listener to be started
data.bad_for_seconds: Reload only after the bad state lasts this long
data.notify_on_reload: Create a persistent notification on reload
data.active_probe_interval_seconds: Minimum interval between active Ring API probes
data.source_entity_id: Optional Ring source entity for UI/device linking
data.attach_to_source_device: Attach watchdog entities to the source Ring device

ring_entry_missing_or_ambiguous.title: Ring Intercom Health cannot resolve the Ring config entry
ring_entry_missing_or_ambiguous.description: The configured Ring config entry `{ring_entry_id}` is missing or ambiguous. Open Ring Intercom Health options and choose a specific Ring config entry, or use Auto only when there is exactly one Ring config entry.

reload_loop_detected.title: Ring Intercom Health suppressed reloads
reload_loop_detected.description: The watchdog reached the configured reload budget of {max_reloads} reloads per hour. It will not reload Ring again until the rolling window allows it.

ring_runtime_unhealthy.title: Ring runtime connection looks unhealthy
ring_runtime_unhealthy.description: Ring Intercom Health detected a runtime/API/listener problem: {reason}. If this persists, check Ring integration logs or disable auto reloads.
